purpose: Resolve zone-dependent native reaction formulas, regulator location and growth/source accounting before tissue integration

native_source.scope: Authenticated isolated AST bodies and generated expressions, supplied small concentration arrays and sampled profile/modulator controls; no native network transport or full run_loop

units.basal_and_regulated_decay: 1/s applied to c_mM / nested growth scale
units.standard_free_energy: J/mol configured forward extent; source reversal parameter only
units.native_R: 8.314 J/(mol K); override explicitly supplied per world

formulas.Q: product(1e-3 * product_c**nu) / product(1e-3 * reactant_c**nu), outside each power
formulas.cell_reversible: vmax * alpha * (1-Q/Keq); both saturation coefficients absent
formulas.env_reversible: vmax * alpha * forward * (1-Q/Keq); product saturation absent
formulas.growth: target * (modulation * production * time * alpha_growth - decay * time * c/scale - decay_max * time * alpha_decay * c/scale)
formulas.growth_auxiliary: alpha_growth only; zero when simple_growth is False
formulas.decay_auxiliary: decay*time*c/scale only, unmasked; excludes regulated decay
formulas.matrix: Growth identity columns in molecule order followed by reaction columns in insertion order per zone; repeated entries and both-side species sum
formulas.evaluation_order: All local growth, cell/mit/env reaction rates use incoming concentrations before env then cell Euler mutation in native run_loop; other run_loop actions are out of scope

regulators.cell: cell owner or env[cells.map_cell2ecm], explicit map required
regulators.mit: Always own mitochondrial concentration; configured cell/env tags ignored
regulators.env: env tag samples own environment; cell tag is literal factor 1, including positive direct-inhibitor term 1
regulators.combination: (product ordinary activator Hills + sum independent ! Hills) * product inhibitor Hills * optional signed direct & sum
regulators.star: Trailing * stripped; all generators pass in_mem_tag=False
regulators.rejected_broken: Direct inhibitor before another inhibitor; both activators/inhibitors only direct; malformed zones/lists

domain.state: Finite nonnegative active concentrations; strictly positive participating substrates even if irreversible; padded compartments exactly zero
domain.geometry: Finite positive physical compartment volumes; padding zero
domain.configuration: Unique reaction names per zone; literal string None for irreversible native raw reader, matching nonempty substrate lists, positive finite multipliers/Km/Hill powers; duplicate substrate entries retained
domain.growth: Nonnegative production/decay/time factors; positive nested scale; finite signed sampled modulation; explicit boolean targets
domain.flags: Explicit booleans and neutral route padding; no silent floors, clipping or native branch correction
domain.trial: Finite representable rates, diagnostics and accumulated material; caller rejects negative Euler trials using state predicate

accounting.stoichiometry: Signed concentration/amount conversions, not assumed species conservation
accounting.moieties_charge: Caller-supplied species basis projections expose every unbalanced route; charge output in elementary-charge fmol, no implicit current
accounting.material_residual: current amount - initial amount - stoichiometry times integrated extents

reference: Independent stdlib 80-digit Decimal dictionaries and owner loops
scope_limits: No full native network run_loop, transport/pumping/gating, mit refresh, geometry or tissue parity
No ATP/heat/free-energy closure inferred from delta_Go or raw Hill regulation
Profile selection, sampled modulator values and runtime time factor are explicit inputs
Shared schema/dispatch/stepping/checkpoint ownership remains separate integration work
